arcade.name: Overhead Kick
arcade.description: Only available during S.P.G, this REV Blow has a good horizontal hitbox and travels about 40% of the screen forward. The vertical hitbox is good too but won’t hit opponents at their maximum jump height.

arcade.name: Hishou Getsurin Zan
arcade.description: Only available during S.P.G, Rock's air REV Blow causes hard knockdown and is safe on block.

arcade.name: Reppuu Ken
arcade.description: C and AC version are two hit, the first hit can nullify a projectile and the second can go through the projectile.

arcade.name: Shippuu Ken
arcade.description: A angle is a bit upward, C downward and AC is between both of them. A and C version are only available during neutral and forward jump. REV version fires two projectiles and can be used in any jump direction and also backdash.

arcade.name: Rising Tackle BR
arcade.description: C and AC versions first hit is brake-able(hit & block).

arcade.name: Hard Edge BR
arcade.description: Every versions are Brake-able before they connect with the opponent.

arcade.name: Crack Counter
arcade.description: B and BD version counter mid and high D version counter low The follow-up is 1F and triggers automatically when Rock successfully counters a move. Is able to counter Rev blows

arcade.name: Rage Run
arcade.description: REV Rage Run turns all follow-ups into their REV versions at no additional REV cost.

arcade.name: Type: Layup
arcade.description: Can be used as a cross up

arcade.name: Type: Cut
arcade.description: REV version can combo into light if close enough.

arcade.name: Type: Dunk
arcade.description: REV version is positif, meaning it's a good ender during a REV cancel combo.

arcade.name: Type: Shift
arcade.description: Swaps sides with the opponent when done up close, or simply stops Rock in his tracks when done further away.

arcade.name: Type: Shinkuu Nage
arcade.description: Identical to the standard (632146P) version. B/D Rage Run can use the A, C, or AC versions. BD Rage Run always uses the REV version of Shinkuu Nage, regardless of input, with no extra REV cost.

arcade.name: Shinkuu Nage BR
arcade.description: Rock's special throw, can be used manually at any by doing the 632146+P input or as a Type: Shift follow-up by pressing any P buttons. A version : Is kinda fast and throw the opponent really far away without any way to cancel Rock's animation. C version : Slower, also throw the opponent far away but you can brake it and be able to move before the opponent fall on the ground. In brake version, the throw deal less damage but you have a better advantage and also you can choose to combo(214C, 236236B for exemple). The issue with that is the damage reduction is really high. AC version : Same speed than the A version and have an automatically follow-up that allow Rock to combo with less damage reduction than the C version.

arcade.name: Shining Knuckle
arcade.description: D version is invincible and is brake-able at the third hit.

arcade.name: Shining Knuckle BR
arcade.description: D version is invincible and is brake-able at the third hit.

arcade.name: Power Geyser - Type: R
arcade.description: Resets the Rev meter to 0%, even during Overheat.
